panels.title: Live campaign — follows phase/run changes automatically

options.content: Updates every **10 seconds** and follows the active phase/run automatically. ETA uses a rolling observed rate and is hidden when stale, stopped or draining. **Preparation WAF is not a cache-comparison result.** Live cards use the latest observer point; charts follow the time picker. [Detailed WAF dashboard](/d/kvbench-nvme-waf)
